item.title: Luminous Gris by Maison Alhambra – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Maison Alhambra
Type:
Price: 1.99 - 20.00 (5 variants)

Overview

Luminous Gris is a polished, modern Eau de Parfum from Maison Alhambra's Luminous collection, often compared to Parfums de Marly Castley.

It comes in a textured grey box with a silver crest. Maison Alhambra has not yet published an official note list for it, so we have not listed notes here rather than guess.

Best for

Season: Spring and fall · Wear it: office, everyday · Time: daytime

item.title: Raees Luxury Edition by Arabiyat Prestige – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Arabiyat Prestige
Type:
Price: 1.99 - 20.00 (5 variants)

Overview

Raees Luxury Edition is the black-boxed edition of Arabiyat Prestige's Raees, a fresh woody-aquatic Eau de Parfum for men with a smoky incense heart. Bright lemon and marine calone open over clary sage, then incense and freesia settle into cedar, patchouli, amber and musk.

It is a polished, mineral-fresh scent with more warmth and smoke than a typical aquatic, often compared to Giorgio Armani Acqua di Gio Profumo.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Calone, Lemon, Clary Sage
Middle: Incense, Freesia
Base: Patchouli, Amber, Cedar, Musk

Best for

Season: Spring, summer and fall · Wear it: office, everyday, date night · Time: day or night

item.description:

Type:

Overview

A soft, clean white-floral musk: sparkling mandarin, bergamot and pink pepper open onto freesia, lily, jasmine and a touch of lavender, settling into creamy sandalwood, amber, vetiver and musk. Aura Vanilla Milk is an Eau de Parfum with a powdery, skin-close feel that is easy to wear every day.

Middle: Freesia, Lily, Jasmine, Lavender
Base: Musk, Sandalwood, Amber, Vetiver

Base: Milk Cream, Vanilla, Sandalwood, Musk

item.title: Atlas Canyon by Lattafa – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Lattafa
Type:
Price: 2.45 - 22.16 (5 variants)

Overview

Atlas Canyon is a 2026 flanker of Lattafa's Atlas: a bright, dry Eau de Parfum that opens with a sparkling burst of bergamot and lemon sharpened by fresh ginger, lifts into airy lily of the valley and sea notes, and dries down to clean ambroxan over earthy patchouli, oakmoss and soft musk. Lattafa files it as hesperidic ambery; reviewers describe it as a fresher, airier, less spicy take on the citrus-ginger style of Louis Vuitton Symphony.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Ginger, Bergamot, Lemon
Middle: Lily of the Valley, Sea Notes
Base: Ambroxan, Patchouli, Oakmoss, Musk

Best for

Season: Spring and summer · Wear it: office, gym, everyday · Time: daytime

Try It Before You Commit

Every fragrance wears a little differently on skin. A decant lets you wear it several times, in different settings, before you commit to a full bottle.

item.title: Atlas Glacial Valley by Lattafa – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Lattafa
Type:
Price: 2.45 - 22.16 (5 variants)

Overview

Atlas Glacial Valley is a 2026 flanker of Lattafa's Atlas, and despite the icy name it wears warm: an Eau de Parfum that opens on juicy pineapple, green fig and a cool flick of mint, turns floral and faintly salty with jasmine and sea salt over patchouli, then settles into a sweet, mossy base of amber, vanilla and musk. Lattafa calls it an oriental marine; the pineapple-over-patchouli-and-moss structure puts it in the same fruity, mossy territory as Creed Aventus, softer and sweeter.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Fig, Mint, Pineapple
Middle: Jasmine, Sea Salt, Patchouli
Base: Amber, Vanilla, Musk, Moss

Best for

Season: Spring, fall and winter · Wear it: date night, nights out · Time: day or night

Try It Before You Commit

item.title: Vantage by Rayhaan – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Rayhaan
Type:
Price: 2.25 - 20.35 (5 variants)

Overview

Vantage by Rayhaan is a woody, spicy incense fragrance, an Eau de Parfum that opens with cardamom, bergamot and pink pepper before a resinous heart of frankincense, myrrh and juniper berries takes over. Cedarwood and patchouli give it a dry, structured finish with a smoky, balsamic glow.

Bold, aromatic and long-wearing, for women and men. Reviewers most often compare it to Amouage Decision, with several calling it a very close alternative.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Cardamom, Bergamot, Pink Pepper
Middle: Frankincense, Myrrh, Juniper Berries
Base: Cedarwood, Patchouli

Best for

Season: Fall and winter · Wear it: date night, special occasions, evenings · Performance: long-lasting

item.title: Equinox by Rayhaan – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Rayhaan
Type:
Price: 2.25 - 20.35 (5 variants)

Overview

Equinox by Rayhaan is a bright, polished white floral, an Eau de Parfum that opens on juicy grapefruit and orange blossom before settling into jasmine sambac and airy white tea. Creamy sandalwood and a soft touch of vanilla warm the dry-down without making it heavy.

Clean, luminous and easy to wear for women and men alike. Its note list matches Maison Mataha Printemps Blanc almost exactly, and retailers widely present it as an alternative to that scent; Rayhaan itself has not confirmed the link.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Grapefruit, Orange Blossom
Middle: Jasmine Sambac, White Tea
Base: Sandalwood, Vanilla

Best for

Season: Spring and summer · Wear it: office, everyday, daytime

Overview

Silent Whisper by Mykonos is a soft, fruity-musky Extrait de Parfum for women and men. Juicy fruit and bright citrus open it up, a gentle floral heart of ylang-ylang, jasmine and rose follows, and it settles into a creamy, powdery base of vanilla, amber, musk and soft woods. It is often compared to Xerjoff Erba Gold for its fruity, sweet-musky character.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Fruity Notes, Lemon, Mandarin, Bergamot
Middle: Ylang-Ylang, Jasmine, Rose
Base: Vanilla, Musk, Amber, Sandalwood, Cedarwood

Best for

Season: Spring, summer and early fall · Wear it: office, everyday, date night · Performance: long-lasting
